mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to wage inflation or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.3 million units per month signals strong consumer demand, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.3 million does not correlate with strong consumer demand or if S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to a contraction in supply or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a decrease in FEDFUNDS does not lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 does not correlate with strong job growth or if S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% does not lead to a contraction in demand or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
